title: Labor wins Greens support for trust changes in exchange for scrapping jet fuel subsidies for the wealthy
summary_full: Government also agrees to carve out pensioners from cuts to private health insurance rebates in return for minor party’s support in SenateFollow our Australia politics live blog for latest updatesGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastPrivate jet owners will no longer receive fuel tax subsidies after the Albanese government secured the Greens’ agreement to undo the sweetheart deal in exchange for supporting a controversial minimum tax rate on discretionary trusts.The government is eager to pass four key pieces of legislation before parliament finishes for the year, including laws to create a gas reservation scheme.
